hero.title: One link. One seamless experience.
hero.subtitle: From planning to the final memory - a simple, refined, and emotional process for you and your guests.

steps.title: Create
steps.description: Choose your event type, pick a digital invitation style, and add the details - time, location, text, and image.

steps.title: Invite
steps.description: Publish your event, get a unique link, and share it with your guests. Collect RSVPs and manage them all in one digital space.

steps.title: Experience
steps.description: Guests open the same digital space, take photos, leave voice and text messages, and become part of a shared experience.

fields.label: Guest messages
fields.value: Mariam left a voice message · Giorgi sent a photo · Nino wrote a text

steps.title: Memory
steps.description: After the event ends, all the content created stays in one place. A digital archive is formed, preserving your shared memories for years to come.

cta.title: Plan your event today
cta.subtitle: Create an event that brings your guests together in one digital experience and stays as a lasting memory.
